name: Claremont Institute
summary: A conservative think tank in Upland, California, founded in 1979 by students of Harry Jaffa. It became an early and influential defender of Donald Trump, published Michael Anton's 2016 essay "The Flight 93 Election" and received a National Humanities Medal from Trump in 2019; senior fellow John Eastman later helped Trump try to overturn the 2020 election. Ryan Williams has been president since 2017 and Thomas Klingenstein chairs its board.
